source: retained Binance Spot 8h aligned CSV only
signal: strictly positive prior12 calendar-month closing return, computed at each UTC month-end; zero or negative is cash
signal_close_semantics: close of final 8h candle of prior UTC month divided by final8h close twelve calendar months earlier minus one
execution: next UTC month first8h open entry; exit next UTC month first8h open; closed/reopened monthly even if state stays positive; no partial months or filled gaps
sample: all complete source calendar months with 12month prior endpoints and following-month opening; listing-limited edges excluded by timestamps only
primary_state_endpoint: pooled positive-state mean future alt-minus-BTC gross return minus nonpositive-state mean future alt-minus-BTC gross return; no strategy PnL used to select feature
secondary_state_endpoints: future direction sign accuracy versus always-up baseline
future own gross return by state
trading_diagnostics: long only positive state; fixed one-third initial coin sleeves with cash when inactive; identical unconditionally monthly-long and inverted-state controls; no leverage
cost_accounting: half cost paid at entry and half at exit, multiplicative; gross-minus-total-cost per-event diagnostic also reported explicitly
path: MFE/MAE only held8h bars, excludes exit candle; intrabar order unknown
dependence: UTC entry month pooled across coins; circular moving-block bootstrap of three successive months, 2000 replicates seed20261010; intervals descriptive only
controls: 500 within-calendar-year month permutations shared across symbols seed20261010
robustness: separate KuCoin same-definition venue replication if Binance gates pass
decision: any failed gate rejects this definition; all gates passing gives development-interesting only and requires separate power/cost/replication design before future freeze
source_interpretation: literature motivates persistence; this long-only crypto/USDT/no-vol-target specification is an original adaptation, not a paper replication
